name: 行星・Fable
description: 科幻電影劇照：衛星地平線上，一顆帶環的氣態巨行星。恆星繞著它走——待命是側光、思考雲帶翻湧、執行時夜面閃電與極光、收尾日出破限、等你則整顆行星日蝕只剩一圈呼吸的大氣光。每個 session 是地平線上一艘小船。
description_en: A sci-fi film still: a ringed gas giant over a moon's horizon. The star moves around it: side-lit when idle, churning bands while thinking, night-side lightning and aurorae while working, sunrise over the limb when wrapping up, and a full eclipse with a breathing ring of atmosphere while waiting for you. Each session is a small ship above the horizon.
